name: Claudette Belfrau
original_name: クローデット・ベルフラウ
source: Daughter of the Belfrau family, large conglomerate in France. Her family have rivalry with Himegami family, and before she transferred to school, due to her experiencing hardships from competing with [url=/c61943]Arisu[/url] in different contests, Claudette sees her as a rival. Although, Arisu only sees her as a good friend.
